name: MainStreet Cleveland

notes: Craft beer bar in downtown Cleveland with weekly Singles Night (Tuesday), monthly Beer Share (third Sunday), and occasional special events.

notes: Year-round Sunday farmers market at First Street Square in downtown Cleveland. 20+ vendors, 11am–2pm weekly.

notes: Cleveland nightlife venue with weekly Singo (Tue), Karaoke (Wed), Open Mic (Thu), and Live Music (Fri–Sat). Smoke-free bar with covered patio.

name: National Cornbread Festival

name: Lula Lake Land Trust
notes: 8,000+ acre preserve on Lookout Mountain, GA. Open to public first and last weekends of each month only. $16 reservation required via Eventbrite, gate closes at 1pm.

name: Walker Rocks
notes: Walker County, GA community events org. Hosts events at Gordon Lee Mansion, Fricks Cave Preserve, and other local venues in Chickamauga.

name: Lookout Winery

name: Ketner's Mill
notes: Annual Country Arts Fair held third weekend of October in Whitwell, TN. 150+ artisans, live bluegrass, food vendors. Est. 1977. $8 admission.

name: Jasper Main Street
notes: Downtown Jasper community events org. Runs Foothills Festival (Sep), Downtown Throwdown (Oct), Apero on Main (Oct), and other seasonal events.

name: Rabbit Valley Farmers Market
notes: Weekly Saturday market in downtown Ringgold, May–Oct, 9am–1pm. Special events include Chili Cook Off (Sep 26), Family Fall Festival (Oct 31), Holiday Market (Nov 14).

name: Nothin' Like Ringgold
notes: Ringgold city event hub. Hosts Front Porch Fridays (weekly Fri acoustic music at Benton Coal), Cruzin the Depot (first Sat monthly), and seasonal community events.

name: Southern Adventist University

name: The Commons Collegedale

name: Cambridge Square
notes: Outdoor shopping/dining district in Ooltewah with free Saturday live music from late April through October. robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot. 2026 artist schedule embedded in images — update dates manually each season.

name: Puckett's Restaurant
notes: Downtown restaurant with a recurring live music calendar featuring local singer-songwriters, bluegrass, and country acts several nights a week.

name: Hi-Fi Clyde's

name: Cherry Street Tavern

name: Tremont Tavern
